name: ip-lookup
title: Look up where an address lives
description: Looks in the IP map and tells you the answer with where it came from; if the map was wrong, you say so and the correction is filed.

steps.title: Look in the IP map
steps.prompt: Find where {{inputs.address}} lives in the person's IP map notes (use /gt:gt-query). Answer in a sentence and quote where the answer came from. If the map turns out to be wrong, say so and file the correction with /gt:gt-work.
